mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) directly reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, compressing the cost of capital and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals labor market weakness, triggering a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 225.0), a CPI reading above 225.0 signals persistent inflation, triggering a Fed tightening response and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 225.0, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) reading below 550.0 (thousand units) signals a housing market collapse, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 550.0, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, which leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS increases and UNRATE declines in the same month, SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong consumer spending regime (RSAFS > 395000.0 million dollars), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS < 395000.0) signals a consumer pullback, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS < 395000.0, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
